text: Ed Harley, a widowed storekeeper in the hills, finds his young son Billy [fatally struck by a teenage camper's dirt bike|wrong|an accident and its guilt]. Mad with grief, he goes to the witch Haggis, who warns that [vengeance carries a terrible price|rules|everything has a price], and digs a corpse from a mountain graveyard for her to wake with his son's blood. The spindly demon Pumpkinhead [stalks the campers one by one|wants|revenge for a wrong], and Ed feels every killing through its eyes.
